research_question: Can atomic submit-and-clean-replay rescue pre-existing goal-aware F+O Official failures across terminal target-state failure and candidate non-delivery?

selection.rule: Include every case whose scientifically eligible DeepSeek F+O control in the consumed Bad-6 study failed end to end.
selection.outcome_used_for_selection: Historical F+O control failure only; no atomic outcome existed when this file was written.

treatment.description: One continuous free Agent session; final submission atomically validates and clean-replays the whole bootstrap, and replay failure returns executable feedback to the same session.

outcomes.primary: EnvBench Official rescue count among the four selected historical F+O failures.
outcomes.mechanism: Candidate formation, atomic replay activation, Fail-to-Pass repair, and final replay-Official agreement.

claim_limits: This is an outcome-conditioned consumed-development rescue screen, not an unbiased paired effect estimate.
Historical controls are not rerun and atomic outcomes cannot rescore them.
Do not tune package-specific or network-specific rules on these cases.
Promotion requires rescue across more than one failure mechanism before a new prospective paired batch.
